entries.name: Lanternblade
entries.role_summary: Balanced melee. Easy to start, rewards good parry timing.
entries.playstyle: Fight up close with a lantern-tempered katana. Guard and parry to build spirit, then spend it on flame arcs. The Phase 1 starting archetype.
entries.basic_attack_note: Four-hit light chain, two-step heavy with an optional charge.

entries.name: Starfletcher
entries.role_summary: Ranged marker. Tags enemies with star-points and detonates the links.

entries.name: Maskdancer
entries.role_summary: Stance switcher. Mask swaps change the moveset mid-combo.

entries.name: Foldcaller
entries.role_summary: Summoner. Commands paper familiars that scout, shield and swarm.

entries.name: Bellstriker
entries.role_summary: Martial artist. Builds resonance with hits, releases it as shockwaves.

entries.name: Duskrunner
entries.role_summary: Assassin. Blinks through shadows, strikes from behind, hard to pin down.
